$comment: Pre-approves exactly the commands this project runs, and nothing wider. Each entry names the script and subcommand rather than a bare interpreter or a bare 'docker', so an approval here cannot be reused to run something unrelated. Note what is absent: no 'docker compose down -v' (destroys data), no 'purge --yes' and no 'suppress' (both change records), and no plain 'python3' or 'curl'.
